Commentary.Commentary: Colin de Grandhomme then took it upon himself and up the ante with a fine fifty, his maiden in this format. South African bowlers had a tough and tiring day as Morkel and Rabada gave it their all. They ended up with a 4-fer apiece while Maharaj got two to his name. The hosts are in a strong position and if they are to push themselves for a win, they need to snare quick wickets to put the Proteas further under the pump. Will they be able to do so? Join us in a bit to find out.

So, South Africa have wrapped it up quickly after taking the third new ball. But the hosts will be pretty pleased with their batting effort as they have managed to swell the lead to a competitive one. Skipper Williamson and Raval laid the foundation and once the latter departed, Santner provided a helping hand. NZ weren't able to score runs freely this morning but came back well in this session. Williamson missed out on a double ton while Santner was dismissed just at the stroke of lunch.

Welcome back for the post-lunch session. Can the Proteas wrap up the lower order quickly or will the Kiwis get their lead to the 150-run mark? We shall find out as the players and umpires make their way out to the middle. Kagiso Rabada to continue his over. COLIN DE GRANDHOMME is the new man in.
.....DAY 4, SESSION 2.....

New Zealand's session although the progress was slow with both Williamson and Santner appearing keen to bat out the session. They couldn't entirely succeed but ensured that there was no collapse for the Kiwis although the skipper would be disappointed at missing out on a double ton. Santner played a handy knock before falling at the stroke of lunch. South Africa's bowlers were quite tidy and the visitors will take some heart from the fact that they didn't allow the Kiwis to score quickly. Let's see how many more can NZ add to their tally after lunch. Join us in a while for the second session.

FOUR! Clipped away! First boundary of the day. Rabada strays onto the pads and Santner clips it away nicely down to the fine leg fence. Lead is now 17.
Length ball on leg stump, Santner looks to flick but misses as the ball brushes the pads on its way through to de Kock.
Full and angled in around middle, tails in to rap Santner on the pads as he looks to flick. Stifled lbw appeal but probably swung a bit too much.
Length ball angled in around off, tucked past mid-wicket for a single.
Banged in short around off, Williamson ducks under it with ease.
Length ball outside off, KW leans forward and blocks well.
Good length outside off, Santner stands tall and blocks to cover.
Length ball outside off, another leave from Santner.
Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
On the shorter side outside off, Williamson steers it through point for a single.
Shortish outside off, Williamson rocks back and bunts it to the off side.
Back of a length outside off, KW hangs back and blocks.
Fuller ball on the stumps, Santner pushes it towards mid on.
Spears it in the zone outside off, Santner leaves it alone to the keeper.
Full and outside off, blocked solidly off the front foot.
Length ball outside off, Santner lets it pass.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and defends well.
Good length outside off, Santner defends with the full face of the bat.
BANG! That's shaken Santner up! Another short ball and he tries to fend awkwardly but misses. Gets rammed on the helmet as the ball goes to mid-wicket. Leg bye taken.
Back of a length outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Beauty! Dug in short around off, Santner looks to fend at it but decides to leave it at the last moment. Too late and he is lucky not to get a feather on that.
Back of a length around off, Santner keeps the rising ball down towards FSL.
Back of a length outside off, forced off the back foot past cover for a single.
Good length outside off, defended nicely from the crease to cover.
Angles in a fuller ball around off, Santner is tight in defence off the front foot.
Very full and outside off, leans forward and blocks well.
Fifth 150-plus score in Tests for Williamson.
Back of a length outside off, pushed off the back foot through cover for a single.
Slips one full and down the leg side, Williamson looks to flick it away but misses.
Fuller around middle, leans across and jams it towards mid on.
Full and outside off, Williamson leans forward and pushes it to short cover.
KAGISO RABADA to bowl from the other end!
Shortish outside off, punched through backward point for a single to keep strike.
On a length and in the channel outside off, Kane gets back and pushes it away towards backward point.
Touch fuller and outside off, Williamson gets behind it and blocks.
Bowls it on a length and around off, Williamson defends it off the front foot with soft hands.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, worked towards the leg side.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Williamson swivels a bit and pulls it towards the man at short mid-wicket who dives to his right to stop that one.

It's time to get underway. The players and umpires have made their way out to the middle. Can NZ pile on the agony or will the visitors sneak in a few scalps? Let's wait and find out. KANE WILLIAMSON and MITCHELL SANTNER to continue with the bat. MORNE MORKEL to start off with the bowling proceedings. Here we go!!!

Hello and welcome to our coverage of the fourth day's play. New Zealand enjoyed a good day yesterday with skipper Williamson's ton being the cornerstone. They have their noses in front and will want to dig in to get a really big lead. South Africa will want to make use of the newish ball and try to minimize the damage. Weather seems really good and we are set for a scheduled start.
.....DAY 4, SESSION 1.....

South Africa's pacers were good in patches with Morkel impressing in the first half of the day while Rabada shone with the second new ball. There wasn't much help off the surface until later in the day when the conditions became overcast. The lead for NZ is just 7 and the visitors will want to limit it as much as possible. Let's see how the first session pans out tomorrow. Weather forecast isn't great for the next two days as well and so the Kiwis will have to call the shots. Join us at 1030 local tomorrow for the fourth day's play.

A really good day for New Zealand. Skipper Kane Williamson seized the initiative with a fluent unbeaten ton and his 190-run stand with Raval deflated the Protea bowling. The latter was unlucky to miss out on a well-deserved ton but he had more than done his job. The second new ball saw South Africa picking up a couple of quick wickets but Williamson stood firm to take the Kiwis into the lead.
FOUR! Flattish around middle and off, Mitchell Santner goes back and whips it through mid-wicket for a boundary. STUMPS ON DAY 3!
Tossed up outside off, Santner comes forward to defend but the ball turns in a long way and hits him on the pads. No real appeal as it was going down leg.
Floats it up around middle, defended away on the leg side.
Bowls it in the rough outside off, Santner makes a leave but the ball almost kisses the off pole.
Tossed up outside off, Santner lunges forward and drives it past covers. Rabada gives it a chase and keeps them down to a couple.
NZ lead by 1 run! Tossed up around middle and leg, Williamson looks to flick but gets it off the inner half towards the leg side for a single.
Short and quicker through the air, Santner punches it back to the bowler.
Flattish around middle and leg, Santner goes back and defends it towards short leg.
Around middle and leg, driven towards mid on.
Loopy around off, Santner punches it off the back foot towards covers.
Floats it up around off, pushed back to Duminy.
Loopy delivery around middle and leg, flicked behind square on the leg side for a single.
JP DUMINY is back into the attack!
Flattish around off, Santner offers a dead-bat defense.
Loopy delivery around off, Santner goes back and punches it towards covers.
Floats it up outside off, Santner plants his front foot across, makes sure he covers the sticks and then leaves it alone.
Flat and outside off, left alone.
Slider around leg, wristed through mid-wicket for a single.
Floats it up around middle, Williamson defends it towards the leg side.
KESHAV MAHARAJ is brought back into the attack!
Santner stands tall and defends it down towards the off side.
Length delivery on off, Mitchell defends it with a straight bat.
beaten! On a length and around off, Santner looks to poke at it but the ball nips away beating the outside edge. Santner is lucky to get away from it.
Good length ball on off, pushed away on the off side.
Short but it's angling down leg, Santner ducks to evade it.
On a good length and serves it outside off, Santner leaves it alone.
Angles it on the pads, glanced fine down the leg side for a single to keep strike.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Shuffles a bit and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Edged but falls short! The edges won't carry when Williamson is batting! On a length, moving away a shade, Williamson pushes it away with soft hands and as a result goes past Amla at first slip and de Kock for a boundary.
Short of a length ball outside off, some bounce off the deck, Williamson has got nothing to do with it.
Fuller on middle, Williamson defends it gently.
On a length and around off, pushed towards the off side.
The light meters are out again and the umpires are having a look to it.
Stays behind the line and keeps it out.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Santner looks to fend it away but the ball takes the gloves and falls towards the vacant short leg region.
Length ball outside off, dabbed towards the off side for a single.
Fuller and angling in, flicked wide of mid-wicket for a couple.
Fuller and angling in on the pads, Santner flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Bowled off a no ball! Oh dear, that's so sad! On a length and pitches it outside off, it jags back in sharply and Santner is late to bring his bat down and the ball goes off to take the off pole. Philander is absolutely gutted at himself but he has only himself to blame.
Good length, jagging back in as Santner flicks it to deep square leg for a couple.
Fuller and just around off, Mitchell offers a front foot defense.
On the fourth stump line, defended down watchfully.
Angles it on the pads, tucked towards the leg side for a single.

On middle and further going down leg, Santner misses his flick as the ball goes of something to the keeper behind. SA appeal but the umpire turns it down. In fact, the Ball Trackers shows it's pitched in line and would have gone on to hit the leg stick.
Bangs in a short ball on off, Santner ignores it.
Good length, angling in on middle and leg, the Kiwi skipper works it off his hips down to fine leg for a single.
Fuller and wide outside off, Williamson makes a watchful leave.
Short of a length ball, angling in on middle, the batsman sits under it.
Good length around off, Kane defends it down solidly.
Marginally full on off, MS punches it towards mid off for nothing.
Stays behind the line and offers a solid straight willow.
Good length delivery on middle, Santner brings his bat and pad together to defend it down on the pitch.
Similar ball but this time Williamson hits it a bit square on the off side and runs one.
Back of a length ball outside off, Kane gets on top and punches it towards covers.
Good length ball on middle, Williamson gets back and defends it towards mid on.
Another short ball by Rabada, the batsman has no harm it letting that go over him.
Ahhh! What a ball! Slants it across from the left-hander and it swings away a touch as Santner has a tame push at it. The ball just whizzes past the outside edge to the keeper.
Shortish on middle, Santner ducks to evade it.
Fuller on off, pushed towards the cover region.
A low full toss, shaping back in, too easy for Santner who flicks it off his pads to deep square leg and opens his account with two runs.
MITCHELL SANTNER is the new man in.

OUT! Got him... yes gone! Henry Nicholls bags a golden duck! Rabada bowls a length delivery, down the leg side, not a wicket-taking delivery by any means. Nicholls looks to help it on its way down the leg side but gets a faint edge through to de Kock who completes the formality. They appeal but Henry doesn't wait, he starts to take the long way back to the pavilion. NZ now trail by 19 runs.
Stays back and defends it down gently.
Angles in a length ball on middle, Williamson gets across to tuck it away but gets a leading edge which dies down instantly.
Fullish around middle and leg, blocked by KW.
Full and sliding down leg, left alone.
Fuller on middle and leg, wristed towards mid on.
Touch fuller and in the line of the stumps, defended down gently.
VERNON PHILANDER is back.
HENRY NICHOLLS is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Rabada gets his first! Hurls a length delivery outside off, gets it to nip back in sharply off the deck as Neil Broom decides to shoulder his arms only to he trapped on the pads. A loud appeal for LBW and it's given by the umpire. Broom walks towards his skipper and asks if he should take the review but Williamson says no. Replays show it to be clipping the top of off stump, so the umpire's call would have stayed. NZ trail by 21 runs!
On the pads, flicked through the on side for a single.
On a length and outside off, dabbed in front of the slip cordon with an angled willow.
Another short ball on middle, Kane is happy to sit under it.
Bouncer going down leg, Kane ducks under it.
Angled in on the pads, nudged through mid-wicket for one.
Touch fuller around off, blocked.
Williamson covers the line and defends it down.
Back of a length outside off, Neil gets on top of it and punches it past covers for three.

FOUR! Edged and goes through! Short of a length delivery outside off, Broom throws his bat at it but the ball bounces a bit more, takes the outside edge and sneaks past gully in a jiffy for a streaky boundary.
Shortish outside off, Broom arches back to evade it.
On the pads, nudged fine down the leg side for a single.
Good length, jags back in from around off, Broom lifts his bat to let it go.
Outside off, left alone.
Length delivery on middle, tucked towards the on side.
On a length and nipping back in a touch, Neil leaves it alone.
On a length and straightens a bit, Broom looks to poke at it but gets beaten.
Short outside off, cut through point for a single.

FOUR BYES! Rabada errs in line and sprays on the pads, Williamson misses his flick and the ball kisses his pads and races down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Rabada oversteps as well and hence called as a no ball.
FOUR! EDGED BUT SAFE! Back of a length around off, squares up Broom a bit as he looks to push at it. The thick edge flies just past gully to the fence for a boundary.
NEIL BROOM is the new man in.

OUT! GONE! Heartbreak for Raval and he has to go. It's another Quinton de Kock special! The opener was totally into a shell over the last two hours or so and now has to walk back without his century. Back of a length outside off, nips in a touch as Raval pushes at it but gets a faint inside edge down the leg side. De Kock dives full length to his right to take another superb catch. Ends a marathon knock from Raval and a very fruitful 190-run stand.
Slips it well down the leg side, left alone to the keeper.
Shortish around middle, swivels to pull it down to long leg for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Williamson taps it towards point.
Back of a length around off, Williamson rises on the toes and blocks well.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and defends firmly with the full face of the bat.
Shortish outside off, blocked off the back foot.
Back of a length outside off, rises to fend but is beaten as the ball whizzes through to the keeper.
Shortish outside off, Williamson cuts it away to deep point for a single.
FOUR! SMARTLY DONE! Back of a length outside off, Williamson plays it very late with an angled bat and steers it wide of second slip to find the fence.
Shortish around middle, swivels and pulls it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Fuller and outside off, presses forward and defends solidly down the track.
Back of a length closer to off stump, probing line from Morkel and Williamson does well to leave it.
Back of a length outside off, Williamson looks to flash at it but misses.
Good length closer to off stump, blocked solidly from the crease.
Fuller ball on off, leans across and drives it past mid on for a brace.
Back of a length around off, Williamson stays back and blocks well.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and pats it to point.
Shortish again around middle, Raval swivels to pull but gets a faint under edge on to the pitch.
Back of a length outside off, jammed off the back foot to the off side.
Shortish around leg stump, Raval looks to flick but gets a bottom edge on the bounce down the leg side to the keeper.
FOUR! Nicely done! Raval breaks the shackles after a dry spell. Fuller ball on the pads, he gets across and clips it away sweetly to the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary. Good stroke!
Full and around off, pushed back gently to the bowler down the track.
KAGISO RABADA is back.
Good length outside off, KW taps it to point.
Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Length ball outside off, nips back in sharply to rap Williamson on the back thigh. That must have hurt!
Good length outside off, seaming away, ignored by KW.
Fuller ball around middle, KW blocks it solidly down the track to the bowler.

SIX! WOW! What a shot that is! Morkel bangs this short around middle, Williamson swivels and hammers the pull over deep square leg for a flat maximum. Fab stroke. One of the best shots of this match, if not the best!
Full and outside off, presses forward and blocks well.
Back of a length outside off, Williamson sits back and punches it through the covers. The slow outfield prevents the boundary, three runs added.
Good length outside off, a hint of away movement as KW lets it pass.
Length ball outside off, seaming away, no shot offered to that one.
Lovely ball! Length ball outside off, shapes away a touch as Williamson is beaten on the push.
Good length wider outside off, shaping away a bit, left alone to the keeper.
Full and outside off, leans into it and pushes towards cover.
Shortish and outside off, angling in, straightens after pitching as Raval makes a good leave.
Back of a length wider outside off, Raval flashes at it but misses.
Length ball down the leg side, Raval misses the flick.
Dug in short around middle, Raval evades the bumper.
Good length on middle, Kane stays back and clips it wide of mid on for a single.
Full ball outside off, Raval drives it firmly towards mid on.
Fuller around off, driven firmly to mid on where Elgar makes a fine half-stop with a dive.
Back of a length around middle, shapes away sharply after pitching as Raval is beaten completely on the push.
Length ball wider outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Good length closer to off stump, a very good leave by Raval.
The hammer is out to even out the area near the bowling crease.
Back of a length outside off, glides it with an open face through backward point for a single. 250 up for NZ.
Shortish around middle, Raval is struck high on the pads as he looks to block. A bit of nip back off the seam.
Shortish around leg stump, tucked in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Back of a length around leg stump, Raval looks to flick but gets it off the thigh pad down the leg side to the keeper.
Fuller on middle and leg, Williamson goes across and clips it away through mid-wicket. Won't make the fence, three runs added to the total.
It has gotten pretty murky out there. The drizzle seems to have picked up as well.
Back of a length outside off, Williamson doesn't offer a shot to that one.
FOUR! BANG! Shortish and wide outside off, Williamson sits back and flashes the cut through backward point. Made terrific connection and the ball just flew away to the fence.
MORNE MORKEL to share the new ball.
Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Length ball on off stump, Raval wrists it towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Shortish around middle, pulled away down to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and blocks it to cover-point.
Good length on the fourth stump channel, a bit of shape away, left alone to the keeper.
The second new ball is available and taken straightaway by South Africa. VERNON PHILANDER to make first use of the new cherry.
Drifting in from around off, Raval is solid in defence.
Floated around off, Raval blocks it firmly from the crease.
Fuller ball outside off, leans into it and defends solidly.
Floated on a length outside off, stays back to block but is struck high on the pads.

NOT OUT! Floated well outside off, turning in to ping the front pad as Raval is beaten on the forward press. Loud lbw but turned down. SA decide to gamble with the review. Fair delivery and no bat involved either. Hawk Eye shows impact to be outside the line and that settles the issue. It was going over leg stump as well. Raval survives.
SA have taken a review for lbw against Raval. Impact seemed outside the line. Reviews will be reset after this over and perhaps that is why the Proteas have sent this appeal upstairs.
Flatter outside off, sits back and defends well.
Floated around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
FOUR! Smashed away! Elgar has lost the plot completely. Yet another full toss and Williamson launches it over mid-wicket with a slog sweep to find the fence. Runs are bleeding at the moment.
17th Test ton for Williamson.

FOUR! THERE IS THE MILESTONE! Top innings from the skipper and he now equals the record for most Test tons by a Kiwi batsman. Low full toss around off, leans across and whips it away towards the wide long on fence for a boundary. Poor bowling from Elgar.

DROPPED! Raval would have been shattered had he got out to that ball. Another full toss and he looks to repeat the previous shot but miscues it towards mid-wicket where du Plessis leaps to get a hand on it but it doesn't stick. Tough chance, great effort nevertheless.
FOUR! SPANKED! A positive shot after ages by Raval. It's a full toss and he manages to lift it over mid-wicket with a clean strike to pick up a boundary. Highest Test score for him now.
Fuller around off, Raval works it towards mid-wicket.
DEAN ELGAR is introduced into the attack.
Speared wider outside off, KW reaches it and pushes firmly to cover.
Flatter and fuller outside off, blocked firmly from the crease down the track.

FOUR! CREAMED! That's a top shot! Flighted outside off, inviting the drive and Williamson slams it through the covers to find the fence. Not easy to hit it against the turn but he is in supreme touch. Toying with the spinners at the moment.

Floated around off, Raval taps it to short cover and calls skipper across for a sharp single. Had to hurry but eventually made it with ease as du Plessis was off balance while getting ride of the ball to the keeper's end.
Loopy on a length outside off, delays the cut to beat point and gets a single.
Slightly short outside off, Williamson goes back to cut but hits it straight to point.
Tossed up around off, played with soft hands towards short mid-wicket.
Floated outside off, Raval works it with the turn to short mid-wicket.
Full toss but Raval is in his defensive shell and just tucks it towards backward square leg.
Fuller outside off, reaches out to that one and smothers it to the track.
Floated wider outside off, Raval stays back to defend but gets a bottom edge on to the boot.
Flatter outside off, steered to point for a single.
Drifting in on middle, pushed off the back foot to mid on for a single.
FOUR! Slammed! A touch short outside off, this time Williamson sits back and punches it sweetly through the covers. Nice placement and finds the fence.
Almost an edge! On a length outside off, skids off the deck as Williamson is beaten on the cut.
Loopy ball around middle, worked towards mid on for a quick single. Rabada was a bit slow to attack the ball.
On a length outside off, punched off the back foot towards point.
Drops it short outside off, cut away to the left of sweeper cover for a single.
Flighted wider outside off, Raval reaches out and defends well.
Floated outside off, Raval stays back and defends well.
Fuller outside off, leans into it and pats it to mid on.
Drifting in from around off, Raval looks to block but gets an inside edge on to the pads.
Floated outside off, leans across and works it to mid-wicket.
Flatter one around middle, punched down to long on for a single.
Spin from both ends as KESHAV MAHARAJ will continue.
Quicker through the air around off, defended back to Duminy.
A low full toss around off, Jeet just pats it back to the bowler.
Flat and short outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Flighted around off, Williamson pushes it away on the off side with an angled bat.
Nicely done! Tossed up outside off, Williamson gets across and brooms it all along the ground past short fine leg for a couple.
Floats it up outside off, Raval lunges forward and drives it through covers for a single.

Welcome back for the final session. New Zealand would be looking to pile up as many as they can before stumps. South Africa desperately need a breakthrough here. Let's see what happens next. Out walk the umpires and the players. Faf tosses the ball to JP DUMINY after tea. Just a slip in place. Here we go...
... DAY 3, SESSION 3...

Another session pocketed by New Zealand. Effortless batting from Raval and Williamson, hardly looking in any trouble at all. Both of them are nearing their centuries and the stand is now worth 126. The SA pacers tried hard but weren't able to cause much problems. Maharaj got a bit of turn but was handled smartly by the batsmen. NZ are one good session away from where they can dictate the pace of the game. SA will hope a wicket can trigger a collapse. Join us in a while for the final session.
Floated outside off, leans forward and pushes it towards point. TEA ON DAY 3.
Tossed up outside off, reaches out and pushes it towards cover.
Just a bit short outside off, Williamson sits back and punches it to extra cover.
Slider around middle, KW gets across and pats it to mid-wicket.
Fuller and outside off, KW pushes it firmly towards mid off.
Tossed up fuller on leg stump, flicked through mid-wicket for a brace.
Slower ball outside off, Raval lets it through to the keeper.
Banged in short around off, Raval rises on his toes to fend it towards the leg side off the inside half. Did well to ride the extra bounce.
Fuller around middle, Williamson plays across the line and gets it off the inner half to square leg. Single taken.
Short ball around middle, Williamson comfortably ducks under it.
Uppish but safe! Shortish around leg stump, Raval cannot keep the leg glance down but it's well wide of the backward square leg fielder. Single taken.
Shortish around off, Raval hangs back and defends it to the leg side.
Fuller around off, whipped with the turn to mid on for a single. Duminy was slow to react there.
Loopy around middle, premeditated paddle to backward square leg where the fielder is very alert to prevent the single.
Flatter around middle, stays back and wrists it to square leg.
Drifting in from around off, thinks of the sweep first but then adjusts to tap it to FSL.
Floated on a length outside off, stays back to cut but gets a bottom edge to slip on the bounce.
Full and well outside off, gets on the front foot and blocks it out.
Back of a length around leg stump, gets back and tucks it down to fine leg for a single.
Banged in short again around off, Raval sways away just in time.
Short ball around middle, Raval ducks under the bumper.
Length ball on the pads, KW works it behind square on the leg side for a single. It came off the pads, leg bye signaled.
Length ball outside off, Williamson pats it down the track to the bowler.
Back of a length outside off, dabbed towards point.
Tossed up outside off, worked with the turn towards short mid-wicket.
Slightly short and outside off, rocks back and slaps it to sweeper cover for a single.
Looped up well outside off, Raval pushes with hard hands and gets it off the outer half towards the right of point. Single taken.
Flighted wider outside off, Raval gets well forward and lets it pass.
On a length outside off, hangs back and pushes it towards point.
Floated around off, worked off the back foot towards mid-wicket with the spin.
Length ball outside off, jams it with an open face to gully on the bounce.
Fuller this time outside off, KW presses forward and defends solidly.
Dug in short around off, Williamson ducks under the bumper.
Length ball outside off, defends it solidly from the crease.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a brace.
Good length outside off, steered towards point.
Full and tossed up outside off, Jeet Raval presses forward and blocks it out.
Maharaj drops it short again, Kane slaps it past point for a single.
FOUR! Deft, that's deft! Flatter and quicker through the air around off, Williamson goes back and cuts it a bit square of the wicket on the off side for another boundary.
Loopy delivery around off, bunted back to the bowler.
Tossed up around off, turning in, Williamson goes back and defends it down.
Comes forward and defends it back to the bowler.

FOUR! Flurry of runs for NZ! Rabada isn't happy with himself! Bowls a back of a length ball on middle, Raval swivels a bit and pulls it firmly through mid-wicket. That sped away to the fence. 9 runs off the over!
Fuller outside off, Raval pushes it straight to mid off.
Short of a length ball outside off, Raval offers no stroke.
Rabada once again errs in the line and goes a bit too straight, Williamson gets back and wrists it through mid-wicket for three this time.
Strays on the pads, nudged away through mid-wicket for a brace.
Fuller and angling in, Williamson looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards the off side.
KAGISO RABADA is back on!
Drops it short on off, cut through covers for one.
100-run stand between Raval and Williamson!
Unnecessary! Full around middle, flicked towards mid on. The fielder has unnecessary throw at the bowler's end. The ball hits the stumps and deflects as the batsmen cross for a single.
Floats it up outside off, Raval gets back to defend but it hits his gloves and dies down.
Around middle and leg, flicked towards the leg side.
Outside off, turning in, Raval covers the sticks and lets it be.
Flighted ball around off, clipped towards mid on.
Length ball on middle, defended down.
Back of a length, angling in, worked towards mid on.

SIX! What a shot that is! Absolute treat to watch! Philander hurls in a back of a length ball on middle, seems Williamson was up for it as he quickly transfers his weight on the back foot and nails the pull over square leg for a maximum all the way. Williamson completes 5000 Test runs as well!
On a length and swinging away a shade, Kane shoulders his arms.
Good length delivery outside off, punched nicely off the back foot towards the cover fielder.
Now Philander isn't happy with the ball and hence shows it to Rod Tucker. The ball passes through the loop and hence Vernon is asked to continue...
Short outside off, punched towards covers.
Floats it up outside off, Raval looks to drive through covers but gets it off the inner half back to the bowler.
Tossed up wide outside off, Williamson makes room and drives it wide of mid off for a brisk single.
Full around middle and off, nudged through the on side for a single.
Gives it a nice loop around off, pushed back to Keshav.
Floats it up around off, turning in, Jeet flicks it in front of square.
Nicely tossed up outside off, Raval defends it off the inside half towards short leg.
Full and swinging heavily outside off, the Kiwi skipper ain't interested in it.
Once again it's in the corridor outside off, KW is happy to let it be.
Back of a length, getting some good away shape, Kane shoulders his arms.
Pitches it up around off, a hint of away movement, Williamson drives it straight to mid off.
Very full and just around off, Kane offers a solid front foot defense.
On a length and shaping away a touch as Williamson carefully leaves it alone.
Drinks are on the field!
Almost a yorker on off, Raval digs it out on the off side.
Once again gives it a bit more flight outside off, Jeet goes for the slog sweep but the ball goes under the bat to the keeper.
A loud shout for an LBW! Tossed up around off, it turns back in sharply to ping Raval on the front pad. They appeal long and hard but the umpire shakes his head and rightly so.
Floats it up outside off, Raval sits down on one knee and looks to slog sweep but mistimes it towards short mid-wicket.
Nicely tossed up around leg, flicked through backward square leg for a single.
Pitches it outside leg, from over the wicket, Williamson is happy to pad it away.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Shortish outside off, chopped through cover-point for a single.
FOUR! How good was that? Back of a length ball on middle, Williamson goes back, hops a bit and wrists it elegantly through mid-wicket for a boundary.
On a length and around off, Williamson pushes it with an angled bat towards gully.
Gets behind the line and defends it back down the wicket.
Short and hurled well wide outside off, Kane looks to cut but ends up chopping it to the point fielder.
Back of a length ball outside off, Williamson punches it towards the man at mid off. Philander will have to reload as he overstepped.
Full around off, defended into the ground off the front foot.
Hits one of the roughs outside off, gets it to turn in sharply but Raval plants his front foot across, makes sure he's covered the stumps before leaving it alone.
26th Test fifty for Kane Williamson!

That's nicely done! Floats it up around middle and leg, Williamson goes back and flicks it off his pads to deep mid-wicket as Bavuma cuts it off. They run three. Another good innings from the Kiwi skipper.
Allows the ball to turn in and then works it through mid-wicket for one.

The umpires are having a look at the ball. It seems to have gone out of shape as it's not going through the ring. Faf du Plessis is around the umpires, having a chat with them. Seems he's unhappy with the ball being changed. The players enjoy a drinks break till then.
Drops it a bit short around off, punched towards covers for a single.
Mid on dropped back now!
Loopy around off, Raval presses forward and pushes it towards mid on for a single.
Good length delivery, angling in, turned towards mid-wicket. Another maiden for Vernon!
On a length and just outside off, another back foot defense by the Kiwi skipper.
Fuller in length and around off, Kane covers the line and defends it with a straight bat back to Philander.
Length ball outside off, defended off the back foot.
Fuller and angling in, KW looks to flick but gets a safe leading edge towards the off side.
Short and outside off, Williamson sits back to cut but it goes on the bounce to gully who does well to stop it with a dive.
VERNON PHILANDER is brought back into the attack!
Floats it up outside off, Raval presses forward in defense.
Loopy ball around off, turning in, defended in front of short leg.
Lunges forward and drives it towards covers for a single.
Tossed  up around off, defended by coming forward.
Bowls a loopy ball around middle, pretty full as well as Williamson digs it out back to  Maharaj.
Tossed up around off, Raval goes back and flicks it past short leg for a single.
Stays behind the line and keeps it out with a straight willow.
Harmless length ball outside off, Williamson makes an easy leave.
Back of a length ball on middle, turned towards the man at short mid-wicket.
Touch short and outside off, KW stays back and taps it towards the off side.
Fuller and coming back in sharply from around off, Kane shoulders his arms to it.
FOUR! Morkel goes for the yorker but overpitches a bit on the pads. Williamson is very good on the on side as he flicks it through mid-wicket and picks up another boundary to his name.

FOUR! Quick hands from Raval! This is tossed up around middle, he gets across and wrists it away through mid-wicket with the turn. Beautifully done and the ball races away to the fence for a boundary.
Flatter ball outside off, sits back and defends towards cover.
Drifting in from around off, blocked solidly from the crease towards FSL.
Tossed up outside off, presses forward and blocks it out.
Floated outside off, sits back and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Floated on a length outside off, sits back and blocks it towards the off side.

Is there an edge there? NO! Good length closer to off stump, Raval leans forward to block as the ball goes through to de Kock. Belated appeal for caught behind but the umpire isn't interested. Understandably so as there was daylight between bat and ball.
Fuller on leg stump, shuffles a bit and flicks it down to long leg for a single. 150 up for NZ.

FOUR! TOP SHOT! Back of a length ball outside off, Williamson rises on his toes and punches it sweetly through cover-point as the ball races to the fence for a boundary. Got on top of the bounce nicely.
Back of a length around off, tucked gently towards short mid-wicket. Slight hesitation but they get the run eventually.
Fuller on middle and leg, leans across and whips it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller and around off, leans forward and blocks it solidly to short cover.
FOUR! Up and over! Drifting in from around off, Williamson gets across a bit and slog sweeps it uppishly over mid-wicket. Clean strike and finds the fence.
Full and outside off, reaches out and pushes it towards cover.
Tossed up fuller outside off, presses forward to that one and blocks.
Slightly short and outside off, a bit wide and Williamson cuts but cannot beat point. It was a bit aerial too.
Flatter ball around off, KW hangs back and defends it towards cover-point.
It's getting slightly overcast again.
Flighted around middle, leans into it and blocks well.
Shortish outside off, Williamson sits on the back foot and punches it through cover-point for a single.
Back of a length outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Something fell into Williamson's eye probably and so  he pulls out from the delivery.
Dug in short around middle, Raval swivels to pull it away nicely. Fine leg fielder scampers a few yards to his right to make the stop. Single taken.
Length ball outside off, Raval plays with an angled bat towards third slip as Bavuma from gully gets across to make the stop.
Back of a length wider outside off, easy leave for Raval this time.
CRACKING BALL! Good length angled away closer to off stump, shapes away late to beat the outside edge as Raval is beaten on the push.
Low full toss around middle, Williamson misses out on the scoring opportunity as his flick goes straight to mid-wicket.
Flighted around off, presses forward and smothers it down the track.
A bit short outside off, Williamson goes back deep in the crease and cuts it to cover-point who is a bit deep.
Flighted outside off, Raval looks to flick but gets it off the inner half through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy and a bit short outside off, defended solidly towards cover.
Floated outside off, Raval gets back and defends it well.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and defends well.

Good length around leg stump, Raval misses the flick and the ball goes off the pads down the leg side. De Kock fumbles to let the ball through to the deep and the batsmen cross over. Leg bye signaled.
Speared well outside off, Raval ignores it.
That was really close! Morkel gets this to nip back in late and sharply as Raval makes the leave. That wasn't far away from the off pole although it was always going over the sticks.
Third slip moves wider.
Another length ball, this time wider outside off, another leave from Raval.
Good length in the fourth stump channel, Raval leaves it alone.
Flighted nicely around middle, KW gets well forward and smothers it.
Loopy around off, Williamson makes room and this time connects the late cut well enough to beat backward point. Couple more to the total.
Floated around off, Williamson looks for the slog sweep but gets a thick inside edge on to the boot. The ball dies in front of slip.
Quicker ball around middle, worked away to the leg side.
Loopy outside off, Williamson sits back and plays the late cut as an afterthought. Cannot beat backward point.
Drifting in around middle, worked away towards the leg side.
KESHAV MAHARAJ comes on to bowl.

Edged but safe! Raval needs to tighten up. Probably a big lax after the lunch break. Fuller ball outside off, looks to drive without footwork and gets a slice that just falls short of the gully fielder.
That's a peach! Length ball outside off, not quite the driving length but Raval tries to get it away through cover on the up. The ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Length ball drifting on to the pads, Williamson tucks it through backward square leg for a single.
50-run stand between Raval and Williamson.
Fuller and outside off, Raval pats it gently to cover-point for a quick single. Good running. This has been a soothing partnership that has built on the opening stand.
Short of a length around off, Raval mistimes the pull in front of square leg.
Full and outside off, nipping in late as Raval makes a leave.

Welcome back for the second session. The weather is holding up well for now with clear blue skies. Can SA bounce back after two rather tough sessions? Let's find out as the players and umpires make their way out to the middle. MORNE MORKEL to start proceedings after lunch.
.....DAY 3, SESSION 2.....

Good little mini session for the Kiwis. They lost Latham early today but not before he had completed a fine fifty. Morkel was the man to provide the breakthrough although he owed a bit to de Kock's brilliance behind the stumps. Raval too got to his fifty and has looked solid with the fluent Williamson for company. There hasn't been too many demons in the pitch apart from the minimal swing and spin. SA will hope to create more chances after lunch while the Kiwis will seek consolidation. Join us in a while for the second session.
Loopy delivery around middle, Kane Williamson nicely lunges forward and keeps it out gently. LUNCH ON DAY 3!

A loud, loud shout for a caught behind but it's turned down! Tossed up around off, turns away a bit as Williamson gets back to cut it away on the off side. It goes through to de Kock who starts to celebrate. The umpire shakes his head and the South Africans look towards Faf. The Protea skipper isn't too keen to go upstairs and when he decides to opt for the review, the umpire informs he's late. Nothing spotted on Snicko and SA save a review here.
Short and flat outside off, Kane goes back and cuts it straight to the point fielder.
Tossed up outside off, Williamson presses forward and pushes it back to the bowler.
Short again and outside off, hit through point for a single.
Short and flat around off, punched off the back foot towards cover.

FOUR! That was a risky stroke to play! Rabada bowls a full length delivery, it's nipping back in as Williamson shuffles a bit to work it across the line. Gets it off the middle of the bat and the ball races through backward square leg to find the fence. Had he missed it, he would have been plumb.
Outside off, KW leaves it alone again.
In the channel outside off, Kane lifts his bat to let it go.
Fuller and angling in on the pads, Williamson gets across and flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Shortish on off, tapped off the back foot towards point.
Back of a length ball, around leg, Raval looks to flick but gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
Slider around off, pushed back to Keshav.
Darts it around middle, Williamson jams it out gently.
Floats it up around off, Kane drives it towards the cover fielder.
Williamson lunges forward and blocks it out.
Loopy delivery around leg, Williamson looks to flick but it goes straight towards the man at short leg.
Tossed up around middle, pushed towards mid on.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked towards mid on.
On a length and just around off, Raval has a tame push at it but gets beaten.
5th Test fifty for Jeet Raval!

FOUR! Edged and away! Jeet Raval reaches another fifty of the series. This lad continues to impress, doesn't he? Gets a full ball outside off, Raval looks to drive it on the up but his bottom hand comes off and hence gets an outside edge which goes past backward point for a boundary. A raise of a bat from the southpaw. Can he make a big one?
Overpitched outside off, Williamson unfurls a punchy drive through covers and some good running between the wickets allows him to come back for the third.
Angles on on the pads, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Hits the deck hard, Williamson ducks ti evade it.
Sends it quick through the air as Raval gets back to punch it towards the point fielder.
Flighted ball outside off, defended back to Maharaj.
Tossed up outside off, Raval prods forward to push but gets an inside edge towards short leg.
Short and around off, Kane goes back and punches it through covers for a comfortable single.
Very full, dipping in, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Tossed up around middle and leg, flicked through square leg for a couple.
This time serves it a bit wide outside off, JR has nothing to offer.
Full and sprayed down the leg, Raval moves inside the line to let it go.

FOUR! Through the gap! Back of a length ball outside off, Jeet Raval looks to push it away from the body but what he does is plays it with soft hands. Gets it off the outer half of the bat and it sneaks through between third slip and gully for a boundary.
Another short ball on off, Raval lets it go.
Bangs in a short ball, outside off, kicking off the surface as Jeet drops his wrists down.
Fuller on off, Raval pushes it towards the man at short extra cover.

SIX! That's a clean strike! Sees the flight does Williamson, wears his skates, gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it with the straightest of bats down the ground for a maximum all the way. He's not allowing Keshav to settle here.
Tossed up around off, KW blocks it out.
Sliding in from around middle, a solid front foot defense on offer.
Comes down the track and jams it back to the right of the bowler.
Comes forward and pats it back to the bowler.
Floats it up around middle, defended into the ground.
Another good take by de Kock! Fuller on leg, Raval looks to leave it alone but it clips his pads and de Kock behind the stumps dives full length to his right to stop it.
Full and served wide outside off, easy leave for Raval.
On a length and nips back in a touch, Williamson punches it towards the off side for a quick single.
Angles in a length delivery, KW works it off the back foot towards square leg.
Length ball outside off, Kane punches it towards point this time.
On a length and outside off, Williamson goes back to punch but slices it towards gully where Bavuma makes a diving stop.
Darts it around middle, it's jammed towards mid on by the Kiwi skipper for a quick single.
Comes from around the wicket and tosses it up around middle, Kane defends it down.
Gets low and across to paddle it just past short leg. A single picked up.
Tossed up around off, it's left alone again.
Flatter outside off, Raval covers the sticks before leaving it.
Floats it up wide outside off, Raval leaves it alone.
KESHAV MAHARAJ is back.
Outside off, Williamson once again plays it with an angled bat towards the gully fielder.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.
Fuller in length and outside off, dabbed towards gully.
Drifting it on to the pads, easy flick through square leg for one.
Beaten! Marginally ahead of a length and in that channel on off, Raval looks to drive it away from the body but is beaten all ends up.
Starts off from over the wicket and hurls in a length ball on off, Raval from within the crease pushes it towards the off side.
KAGISO RABADA is brought into the attack now!
Fuller and swings away outside off, Kane is happy to let it be.
Length ball outside off, pushed off the front foot towards the bowler.
On a length and just around off, Williamson goes back and works it towards mid-wicket for nothing.
Fuller in length and straying on the pads, flicked through square leg for a single. 100 up for NZ!
Good length delivery around off, defended down with a straight bat.
Angles in a length ball on middle, defended by shuffling across towards mid-wicket.
Good length slanting in from outside off, Raval taps it gently towards short cover and they hare across for a brisk single.
Length ball on the pads, Williamson gets across and tucks it down to fine leg for a single.
Full and outside off, solidly blocked off the front foot towards extra cover.
Good length outside off, a bit of extra bounce there as Kane lets it pass.

FOUR! PURE CLASS! Fuller ball outside off, Williamson leans nicely into it and caresses the drive through the covers. Timed it beautifully and kept it all along the carpet as the ball raced to the fence.

Off the edge but sneaks through! Length ball angled in from outside off, straightens after pitching as Raval pushes at it. Gets it off the outer half past the diving point fielder as the batsmen get a single.
Beaten! Back of a length outside off, no footwork from Williamson as he looks to punch it off the back foot. Lucky not to get a nick.
Once again Philander's line is too straight and Raval clips it down to fine leg for a single.
Straying on the pads, Raval works it behind square on the leg side for a couple.
On a length on middle stump, worked towards mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, stays back and pushes it back to the bowler.
Good length angled in around off, Raval blocks it off the front foot towards the leg side.
Fuller and outside off, Raval leans forward and creams it through the covers. The slow outfield means that it won't reach the fence. Three runs added.
Banged in short on off stump, Raval ducks under the bumper.
Full and outside off, Raval lifts his bat to make the leave. Morkel seems to be buzzing now after that wicket. He is a rhythm bowler and can be menacing to face when on song.
Good length angled in from outside off, Raval shoulders arms to make the leave.
Length ball outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Good bouncer around off, keeps coming in with the angle and Raval does well to evade it.
Full and outside off, a hint of shape away, Williamson gets half-forward and blocks.
Length ball on off stump, blocked solidly from the crease towards mid-wicket.

Back of a length outside off, Raval drags the pull towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish ball outside off, tailing away a bit as Raval lets it pass.
Back of a length around off, blocked firmly off the back foot.
In the air....safe! Back of a length outside off, nips in sharply as Williamson gets hit on the thigh pad. The ball bobbles up for a while but dies before point.
KANE WILLIAMSON is the new man in!

OUT! EXCELLENT FROM DE KOCK! Brillliant one-handed catch and South Africa finally break the dogged opening partnership. Length ball in the corridor of uncertainty, nipping away a touch as Latham pushes at it. Gets the nick that flies to de Kock who reacts sharply to dive full stretch to his left and sticks out his left glove to take the catch. Excellent stuff! Latham will be disappointed at wasting the start.  250th Test scalp for Morkel.
Length ball angling in on fourth stump line, no stroke offered to that one.

Very full on off, Tom lunges forward and drives it straight to cover-point fielder.

In the channel outside off, Jeet once again allows it to go through.
Fuller outside off, Jeet watches it go through to the keeper.
Angles in a length ball on middle, clipped off the back foot towards short mid-wicket.

Back of a length from around the wicket, punched off the back foot towards point.
Length ball wider outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Good length around off, Latham looks to block but gets an inside edge on to the pads. There was a stifled lbw appeal but the edge saved him.
13th Test fifty for Latham.

FOUR! Gets it away! Fuller and around middle, Latham gets across to that one and glances it nicely down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Nice way to get to the mini milestone. Welcome return to form for Latham and he will be keen to make this count.
Around the wicket.
Fuller ball outside off, inviting the drive but Latham resists the temptation by letting it pass.
Length ball wider outside off, that's an easy leave for Latham.
Good length outside off, Latham blocks it from the crease towards short cover.
Length ball around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Good length around leg stump, Latham misses the flick and the ball goes off the pads down the leg side towards the short fine leg region. Leg bye taken.
Another full ball on leg stump, Raval glances it down to long leg for a single.
Fuller and around middle, blocked solidly down the track to the bowler.
On a length around leg stump, Raval fails to get bat on his attempted flick and is struck on the pads.
Length ball around leg stump, Raval tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Good length around off, Latham stands tall and defends firmly with the full face of the bat.
Full and around off, Latham defends it solidly from the crease.

FOUR! That one sneaks through. Full and outside off, Latham pushes at it with soft hands. Gets the outside edge that gets between the slips and gully to the third man fence. The good thing for Tom there was that he didn't push with hard hands and so that edge wouldn't have carried anyway.
Fuller length this time around middle, gets across and pats it towards mid-wicket.
Shortish around off, Latham rides the extra bounce and taps it towards point with soft hands.
Back of a length around leg stump, Latham gets across on the back foot and fends it on to the track.
MORNE MORKEL comes on to bowl.
Good length around middle, Raval gets right behind the line of that one and blocks it down the pitch.
FOUR! LUCKY RUNS! Fullish and around off, tails back in sharply as Raval goes for the drive. Gets a thickish inside edge that just eludes the sticks and goes to the fine leg fence.
Back of a length outside off, a bit of width and Raval punches it behind point for a couple.
Full and outside off, blocked well off the front foot, blocked well off the front foot.
Fuller length closer to the off stump, good leave by Raval.
Loud lbw appeal but turned down. Raval is pinged on the pads as he misses the flick to an indipper. That was pitching outside leg.
VERNON PHILANDER to bowl from the other end.
Floated well outside off, gets a big stride forward and lets it pass.
Drifting in from well outside off, again sharp turn for Maharaj as Latham blocks.
Sharp turn and bounce to start the day! On a length well outside off, spins in sharply as Latham plays on the back foot. Taps it towards cover.

The players and umpires are making their way out to the middle. Crucial first session, especially for the Kiwis. The overcast conditions should aid the SA seamers. Let's see how things pan out. Keshav Maharaj to complete the over.
UPDATE 1120 LOCAL - The latest news we are hearing is that play is set to start at 1200 local. The forecast for the afternoon doesn't seem encouraging though.

Hello and welcome to day three of the final Test between New Zealand and South Africa in Hamilton. The hosts started well with the bat yesterday but still have a long way to go if they are to level the series, especially with inclement weather around. It was raining heavily here this morning but the downpour has stopped a while back and it is currently overcast. The outfield remains damp and so a delayed start is confirmed. Inspection at 1030 local. Other updates coming up as we get them.
.....DAY 3, SESSION 1.....

Earlier in the day, de Kock's fluent 90 helped South Africa cross the 300-run mark. NZ's pace attack worked well as a unit, aided by overcast conditions during their bowling. The South African seamers didn't get that assistance but they didn't help their cause either by bowling inaccurate spells. Only Philander looked a bit threatening. The game is nicely set up and tomorrow should be a cracking day, weather permitting. Do join us at 1030 local for the third day's play. Adios!

Excellent finish to the day for New Zealand. Openers Latham and Raval weathered the new ball phase largely untroubled and set up the Kiwi innings well in pursuit of South Africa's challenging total. The Protea bowlers weren't at their best and were guilty of spraying the ball a bit. Having said that, the NZ openers deserve credit and have ensured that the Kiwis are happier side going into stumps on day two.
The umpires come together again and after a look with the light meters, they have decided that it isn't bright enough for play to continue. STUMPS ON DAY 2.

Stays back and keeps it out with a straight bat.
Fuller in length and around off, Raval is rock solid in defense.

Gets behind the line and defends it gently.
Full outside off, left alone.

The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flighted ball around off, defended into the ground.
Full around off, patted towards covers.
That's turned in! Tossed up outside off, Latham lunges forward to cover the line but the ball turns in and bounces a bit more before going into the keeper's gloves.
Tossed up outside off, left alone by Tom.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Goes deep in the crease and tucks it towards short mid-wicket.

In the channel outside off, JR offers no stroke.

floats it up around off, Latham hangs back in defense.

FOUR! Edgy! On a length and just around off, Tom Latham hangs back in defense but gets an outside edge between third slip and gully to the third man fence.
Stays back to this length ball and defends it well down the wicket.

FOUR! That's a classical shot from Tom! He's made it look so good! A genuine half-volley from Rabada and Latham doesn't let it go waste. He leans into it and drives it ever so beautifully through extra cover for a boundary.
Replica of the previous delivery.
Fuller and slanting across, TL makes an easy leave.
Bangs in a short ball wide outside off, Latham doesn't answer it. One bouncer of the over signaled by the umpire.
Very full and pitched around off, Raval drives it past covers and picks up two to his name.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Good length ball, served very close to the off stump line, Raval lifts his bat and lets it go yet again.
Another one outside off, left alone by Jeet.
Short of a length ball on middle, Raval lets it sail over him to the keeper.
Back of a length delivery on middle, defended with a straight bat.

On a length and outside oof, Tom comes forward and across and initially decides to leave it alone but is a bit late to withdraw his bat as the ball goes off the toe end of the bat towards the slip cordon safely.
Good length ball around off, Tom defends it solidly off the front foot.
Very close to the off stump line and an easy leave for TL again.
Prods forward to this full ball and defends it down solidly.
Good length ball, angling in, Latham covers the line and defends it towards mid-wicket.
On a length and just outside off, Latham is happy to let it be.
Drinks break!
In the corridor of uncertainty, Raval sees it go through to de Kock.
A well-directed bumper on middle, Jeet Raval leaves it alone.
Jeet defends it from within the crease.
Short of a length ball on middle, defended with a straight bat.

FOUR! Pulled away in style! Morkel drags his length short on middle, Raval is up for it as he swivels and pulls it firmly through square leg to find the fence. This is the highest opening stand for the Kiwis in this series, surely these two would want to capitalize on it.
Shortish delivery, down the leg side, left alone.
On middle, driven towards mid on.

FOUR! Just past de Kock! Had he taken it, it would be a blinder of a catch! Short of a length ball, angling down leg with some extra bounce which almost does Latham in. It goes off the glove and de Kock behind the stumps dives full length to his right but the ball was too far from his reach. He has plucked a few in recent memory but this was a bit too far for him.
Fuller and curling back in but Tom Latham defends it down solidly.
Angles across a length delivery, Latham watches it go through to Quinton.
Fuller in length and straying on the pads, clipped fine down the leg side for one.
On a length and outside off, Raval has nothing to offer on that one.
KAGISO RABADA into the attack now!
Good length outside off, left alone with ease.
Gets forward to this length ball and pushes it towards point.
TL lets the ball go outside his off stump.
FOUR! Delightful! Fuller in length and width on offer outside off, Tom Latham leans into it and caresses it past extra cover for a boundary.
On a length and outside off, it's very close to the off stump line, Latham doesn't offer any stroke.
Comes from around the wicker and hurls in a length ball, angling in, Tom leaves it alone for de Kock.
Short of a length ball on off, pushed towards point off the front foot.
Good length delivery outside off, JR looks to poke at it but is lucky not to nick one behind.
FOUR! Edged and through! Good length delivery on off, Raval presses forward to defend but gets an outside edge which evades the gully fielder and races to the third man fence.
Fuller in length around off, defended off the front foot gently.
On a length and in the channel outside off, Jeet comes nicely forward and then shoulders his arms to it.
Serves it wide outside off, Raval isn't interested in playing that one.
Good length outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Length ball outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and defends firmly.
Full and around off, Latham looks to block but gets an inside edge on to the pads.
Fuller and around off, swinging in a bit, Latham defends off the inner half to square leg.
Good length outside off, Latham isn't interested to play at it.
Length ball wider outside off, Raval shoulders arms to that one.
On middle and leg, Raval works it through backward square leg for a brace.
Length ball around middle, tucked towards mid-wicket.
Short of a length around off, defended solidly from the crease.
Good ball! Back of a length around off, nips in a touch and beats the outside edge as Raval looks to poke.
Good length outside off, Raval lets it pass almost as an afterthought.

YES INDEED! Latham is safe. Back of a length around leg stump, straightens a bit to strike him high on the pads. Lbw appeal is turned down by the umpire. Morkel convinces Faf to go for the review. Legal delivery, Hawk Eye shows just what we thought, pitching outside leg stump and that seals the deal. It was quite high too anyway, bizarre review from the Proteas. That didn't look to the naked eye at all.
SA have taken a review for lbw against Latham. Was it pitching outside leg?
Back of a length outside off, Latham doesn't offer a stroke.
Dug in short around middle, Latham ducks under the bumper.
The on-air commentators are having a valid point on Morkel. His natural length is back of a length but these conditions demand a fuller length especially with the surface slightly slow.
Shortish around leg stump, Raval swivels a bit and pulls it down to fine leg for a single.
Short of a length wider outside off, that's an easy leave for Raval.
Back of a length around off, Raval is solid in his back foot defence.
Fuller around off, swinging in, Latham covers the movement and defends towards mid-wicket.
Length ball angling across the left-hander, the line is well outside off and Latham has an easy leave.
Full and closer to off stump, Latham gets a good stride forward and blocks strongly to short cover.
Fuller around middle, Latham works it with the inward movement towards mid-wicket.
This one nips back in sharpy from off stump, Latham is late to bring his bat down and is struck on the pads. Stifled lbw appeal but that was a bit too high.
Length ball outside off, Latham makes a leave.
Fuller ball around middle, worked away behind square on the leg side for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Latham sits back and blocks solidly.
Good leave in the end. Length ball closer to off stump, Latham was in two minds whether to play or leave. In the end, he withdrew his bat just in time.
Good length around leg stump, Raval gets an inside edge on the pads as he tries to flick. The ball dribbles to the leg side as the batsmen take a single.
Banged in short outside off, Raval isn't troubled as he lets it pass to the keeper.
Back of a length closer to off stump, Raval doesn't offer a stroke to that one.
Gets on the front foot and defends it down solidly.
Hurls in a length ball, just around off, it curls back in sharply as Latham shoulders his arms. That was close to the off pole.
Fuller length ball outside off, Tom Latham drives it on the up through covers for another couple.
Very full and coming back in sharply as Latham comes across to work it on the leg side. Gets it off the inner half through mid-wicket for a couple.
Length ball, angling in, Tom stays back and defends it towards the leg side.
Fuller in length and it straightens a touch, Latham makes a brave leave.
Short ball from Morkel, Raval does well to evade it.
Full ball outside off, Raval defends it nicely off the front foot.
Fuller around middle, tucked towards mid-wicket.
Good length angled away outside off, Raval lets it pass to the keeper.
Length ball outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Back of a length outside off, blocked solidly off the back foot.

NOT OUT! Good use of the technology by Tom. Fuller ball around leg stump, Latham looks to flick as it goes through to de Kock. Huge appeal for a catch and it is given. Latham opts for the review straightaway. Replays show that it came off the pads and Snicko doesn't detect anything either. The on-field call is reversed and Latham survives.
Latham is pretty confident and his body language shows he's not nicked it.
Latham has been given out lbw. He takes the review immediately.
Almost got into a tangle! Lovely inswinger around middle, Raval gets a faint inside edge that saves him from the lbw. The ball sneaks through the slip cordon towards third man. Single taken.
Good length around off, Latham defends it down the track to the bowler.
Too straight from Philander and Latham clips it down to fine leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, leans forward and dabs it towards mid-wicket.
Full and around off, leans forward and clips it towards mid-wicket.
